mechanism: A decade of chronic negative displacement (B pinned at -1.000) ground the field from its 19.22 peak down to ~6, and the recent month added one channel death (2026-08-12) followed by five straight sessions of unanimously downward-displaced readings under reversal pressure as price set the 5.95 low. On the final session that stored tension drained out: residual tension fell from 0.53 to 0.37 across the day, the reversal condition cleared, and stability firmed to 0.892 while price lifted off the low. The damage is a week old, no channels read dead, and the field is re-knitting into a flat base near 6 — resolution of the down-leg, not fresh structural failure.
